notes.title: Zoo Constructor - finally opens!
notes.content:
If you like Zoo Tycoons this ones for you:
Zoo Constructor- Construct and manage an animal park! 
Economic simulation with complex animal, climate and plant simulation. The constructor has tools for soil, water, roads, fences and plants, personnel, visitor facilities and decorations available. Have fun!

-------------------------------
New Features v1.12:
-------------------------------

 Steam Achievements
 Steam Leaderboards
 snackbooth
 objectives parklevel 5
 8 animal species 
 orangutan
 yak
 leopard
 flamingo
 ostrich
 kangaroo
 armadillo
 racoon
 5 new fences 
 map sahara 
 some balancing and minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Version 1.0.38 live!
notes.content:
- shadow rendering enabled
- lost mission goal text after task switching fixed
- some minor bug fixes
- herd size info listed
- prefered ground type listed
- deselection with right mouse button (click)
- touched objects yellow marked
- autoscrolling at screen margins
- hint texts on build option icons
- radarmap-frame
- some minor bugs fixed
